_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Non-Destructive Testing Training Program
summary: Establishes format, content, and intended use for the written practice describing the training program used to qualify Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) personnel under ASNT TC-1A.
use_relationship:
American Society for Nondestructive Testing (ASNT) TC1A establishes the requirements for a written practice to describe the training program for qualifying NonDestructive Training (NDT) personnel.
This DID contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data product resulting from the work task described in the contract Statement of Work (SOW).
This DID supersedes DI-NDTI-81936.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

children.title: Title of CDRL and CDRL number.
Content.
children.content: As a minimum, the supplier shall have in place a compliant Non-Destructive Testing program in accordance with ASNT TC-1A. Accordingly, specific objective evidence shall be provided to demonstrate compliance.

children.title: NDT Training Program Written Practice:
children.content: The supplier shall have a documented written practice for his/her Non-destructive Testing activities in accordance with ASNT-TC-1A. The supplier shall provide evidence that the training program is properly established by way of submitting a copy of the program or making reference to the same via a statement of compliance including, if applicable, where the program exists within their quality program and/or operating procedures (i.e. excerpt from a Table of Contents; cover page of the program document, reference to a procedure number, etc).

children.title: Level III Examiner:
children.content: When NAVSEA S9074-AQ-GIB-010/248 is specified, the supplier shall have under their employ a Level III examiner available to approve the Welding Training program. If a Level III examiner is not directly employed by the supplier, the use of an accredited sub-contractor is permissible. The supplier shall provide evidence that this requirement has been met by providing a copy of the Level III examiner's credentials.
